items.title: Amory: Building Coherent Narrative-Driven Agent Memory through Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Amory：通过智能体推理构建连贯的叙事驱动型智能体记忆
items.summary: Amory is a working-memory framework that constructs structured memory offline by organizing conversational fragments into episodic narratives, consolidating memories with momentum and semanticizing peripheral facts. On LOCOMO it reports considerable gains over the prior state of the art, performance comparable to full-context reasoning and a 50% reduction in response time.

items.title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
items.title_zh: 别破坏缓存：长时程智能体任务中提示缓存的评估
items.summary: The paper evaluates prompt caching across OpenAI, Anthropic and Google on DeepResearch Bench, covering over 500 agent sessions with 10,000-token system prompts. It finds API cost reductions of 41–80% and time-to-first-token improvements of 13–31%, and reports that strategic cache-block control beats naive full-context caching, which can increase latency.

items.title: Agentic LLMs as Powerful Deanonymizers: Re-identification of Participants in the Anthropic Interviewer Dataset
items.title_zh: 作为强大去匿名化工具的智能体 LLM：Anthropic Interviewer 数据集参与者再识别
items.summary: Focusing on the 125-scientist subset of Anthropic's 1,250-interview public dataset, the author shows that off-the-shelf LLMs with web search and agentic capabilities linked six of twenty-four interviews to specific scientific works and in some cases uniquely identified interviewees. The paper argues such re-identification is now low-effort and outlines mitigations and open problems.

items.title: C-World: A Computer Use Agent Environment Creator
items.title_zh: C-World：计算机使用智能体环境创建器
items.summary: C-World lets users build agent environments from an action space of 5,571 format-unified tools across 204 applications, a task distribution engine, a state controller that injects failures and a combined verifiable/LLM reward. Evaluating nine LLMs, it finds execution rather than planning is the bottleneck and constraint following is the dominant failure mode; fine-tuning on 1,170 trajectories outperforms baselines trained on 119k samples.

items.title: Can We Predict Before Executing Machine Learning Agents?
items.title_zh: 我们能在执行前预测机器学习智能体的结果吗？
items.summary: The paper formalizes data-centric solution preference with a corpus of 18,438 pairwise comparisons and shows LLMs can predict outcomes at 61.5% accuracy when primed with a verified data analysis report. It instantiates FOREAGENT with a predict-then-verify loop that reports 6x faster convergence and +6% over execution-based baselines.

items.title: Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool
items.title_zh: 将反馈蒸馏为“记忆即工具”
items.summary: The framework converts transient critiques into retrievable guidelines through a file-based memory system and agent-controlled tool calls, amortizing inference-time reasoning. On the new Rubric Feedback Bench, augmented LLMs rapidly match test-time refinement pipelines while drastically reducing inference cost.

items.title: Evaluating Robustness of Large Language Models in Enterprise Applications: Benchmarks for Perturbation Consistency Across Formats and Languages
items.title_zh: 评估企业应用中大语言模型的鲁棒性：跨格式与语言的扰动一致性基准
items.summary: A benchmark suite covering text edits, format changes, multilingual inputs and instruction-position shifts finds that minor perturbations cut performance by up to 40 percentage points across 11 models. An 8B Ministral model outperforms most larger ones.

items.title: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide
items.title_zh: FlorianBruniaux/claude-code-ultimate-guide：最全面的 Claude Code 指南
items.summary: A Claude Code guide covering agentic workflows, hooks, skills, MCP servers, quizzes and production-ready templates, described as spanning more than 430K lines.
